name: Người Rừng
description: A proposed Indochinese hominid cryptid reported from the dense forests of Vietnam and Laos, broadly analogous to the North American Bigfoot. Reports cluster in the Vu Quang region of Vietnam and on the Vietnam-Laos border; no specimen has been collected.
regions: Vu Quang National Park (Hà Tĩnh Province)
origin: Reports cluster in the forested mountains of central Vietnam (notably the Vu Quang region) and along the Vietnam-Laos border, with related Batutut/Ujit accounts extending into Laos and reportedly into northern Borneo.
